page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-standard-64 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the arm64 CPU architecture. The instance features 256.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated arm64 processor cores, the n4a-standard-64 is designed for general-purpose workloads. It provides a cost-efficient profile for multi-threaded applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-scale database deployments that benefit from dedicated ARM-based compute resources without requiring local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
